en.afterInstall: Your next good read starts here.
en.afterInstallBody: Once setup is complete, open a practice article. Highlight a phrase and click its icon, or use Ctrl+X (⌘X on Mac).
en.titleHome: Explained — AI Reading Assistant for Chrome
en.titleDownload: Download Explained for Chrome — Installation & API Setup
en.descriptionHome: Explain unfamiliar words and concepts beside your reading with Explained, an AI reading assistant for Chrome powered by your DeepSeek API key.
en.descriptionDownload: Download Explained API edition for Chrome. Follow installation, API key setup and first-lookup instructions.
en.descriptionTry: Practice reading research articles with Explained. Highlight a phrase, then click to explain it with optional nearby context.
en.requirements: Chrome 114+ · Internet access · Your own DeepSeek API key
en.descriptionHelp: Start with the symptom you see. These steps apply to the extension-wasm-offline v0.2.1 API edition.
en.titleApiKey: Set Up a DeepSeek API Key — Explained Guide
en.descriptionApiKey: Connect Explained to your own DeepSeek API account, then choose when to send a reading lookup. This guide covers v0.2.1.
en.titleResearch: Read Research Articles with Explained — Chrome Reading Guide
en.descriptionResearch: A practical way to use Explained with research articles published as HTML. Work from an unfamiliar phrase back to the author’s argument.
en.titleContext: Explain Words in Context with Explained — Chrome Guide
en.descriptionContext: The same word can point to different ideas. This exercise shows what nearby context adds and how to inspect or disable it.
en.descriptionChangelog: The current default download is extension-wasm-offline v0.2.1, the API edition. Website improvements do not automatically update an installed extension.
en.descriptionGuides: Learn to set up Explained, read research articles and interpret unfamiliar phrases with context.
en.guidesHeading: A little guidance. A better read.
en.capabilities: A little help for the next question
features: Read a short explanation beside the article, with optional nearby context.
Request a longer explanation with a fresh web search and source links.
Use News to explore recent coverage, then check the original sources.
